title: Dynatrace Agentic Guide Scenario
description: Manifest for a single demo scenario. One file per scenario; zero engine changes to add a new one.

id.description: Kebab-case, matches the parent directory name.

source_guide.description: UUID of the originating video guide JSON (provenance, not a runtime dependency).

duration_minutes.description: [min, max] expected duration for a typical run.

services.description: Dynatrace service entity IDs the demo is scoped to.

segment.description: Dynatrace filter segment ID to scope queries.

data_objects.description: DQL data objects the hook permits for this scenario.

timeframe.description: How to determine the query timeframe. 'derived_from_problem' = resolver output.

query.description: Path to the DQL file that finds the live problem. Relative to scenario dir.

fallback.description: Path to the fixture JSON to use when the live problem is not found.

business_context.description: Used by the ambient discovery flow to frame the scenario as a live incident.

discovery_hook.description: Template string with {placeholders} for affected_users, duration_min, revenue_impact, failure_rate, service_name, user_action.

objective.description: What the user should understand by the end of this beat.

evidence.description: Paths to DQL files that produce the evidence for this beat.

reveal.description: The insight the beat delivers (internal to the engine; not shown verbatim).

success.description: What user output signals they've grasped the beat (for engine to detect).

nudges.description: Ordered nudge ladder; engine escalates only on silence or explicit 'I don't know'.

deep_link.description: URL template from the source guide JSON, with {{PLACEHOLDER}} variables.

source_step_id.description: UUID of the originating step in the source guide JSON (provenance).
